Every project, regardless of its size, receives the same level of attention, professionalism and commitment to quality. We believe that our reputation is built project by project, client by client, so we treat every job as if it were our most important project.

our_work_p_15: Welcome to the project gallery of Renovations Plus (Renovations 2000). Here you can get an impression of the wide range of work we have performed for our clients, from luxury bathroom renovations to complete apartment renovations. We believe that every project is our business card, and therefore we invest maximum effort in every detail.
our_work_p_16: In the construction and renovation industry, quality is measured not only by the final result visible to the eye, but also by what is hidden beneath the surface. As a leading company in the field, we insist on using the highest quality materials and working according to the most stringent standards. Whether it involves replacing plumbing infrastructure, complex electrical work or precise flooring, we do not compromise on anything less than excellence.
our_work_p_17: The projects displayed on this page demonstrate our ability to deal with both engineering and design challenges. Our goal is to provide every client with peace of mind and confidence that they have made the right choice. When you are looking for a reliable renovation contractor in Israel, experience and results in the field are the best measure of quality.
our_work_p_18: One of the impressive projects we recently completed included a comprehensive renovation of a bathroom in an old apartment in Rishon LeZion. The challenge was to transform a small, dark and outdated space into a modern and luxurious spa room. The process began with total demolition of the room down to the foundation, including removal of old coverings and disposal of waste to an authorized site.
our_work_p_19: In the infrastructure stage, we performed a complete replacement of water pipes with insulated and quality SP pipes, and upgraded the drainage system to prevent future blockages. The waterproofing issue received special emphasis with the use of advanced two-component waterproofing materials, to ensure durability for many years without leaks.
our_work_p_20: Variety of renovation work we performed in the private and commercial sectors
our_work_p_21: Total renovation of a 5-room apartment in Tel Aviv. The project included breaking walls to create an open space for the living room (Open Space), replacing flooring with parquet, decorative drywall work on the ceiling, preparing an internal niche for television and artistic painting. The apartment was transformed from a dark and divided apartment to a modern and bright apartment.
our_work_p_22: The kitchen is the heart of the home, and in this project we focused on creating a functional and designed kitchen. We performed complex preparations for plumbing and electricity for advanced electrical appliances, installed luxury glass wall covering and performed hidden lighting work to complete the atmosphere.
our_work_p_23: Adapting office space for a high-tech company. The project required meeting particularly tight schedules to allow the company to return to rapid operation. We built acoustic drywall partitions, installed suspended ceilings and laid wall-to-wall carpets. Precise and clean execution.
our_work_p_24: Choosing a renovation contractor is one of the most important decisions you will make in the home upgrade process. The market is full of promises, but at Renovations Plus (Renovations 2000) we understand that the real proof is in the field. The extensive experience we have gained over the years allows us to anticipate problems in advance, offer creative solutions and save our clients money and heartache.
our_work_p_25: We insist on complete transparency with the client. Our price quote is detailed and clear, without last-minute "surprises". When we commit to a schedule, we do everything to meet it, understanding that renovation is a stressful period for the household and we want to shorten it as much as possible without compromising the quality of work.
our_work_p_26: Our team consists of experienced professionals certified in their fields - plumbers, electricians, flooring and painting specialists from the first rank.
our_work_p_27: We work only with materials that have Israeli and international standards, ensuring durability for years and an aesthetic appearance that is maintained over time.
our_work_p_28: All our work is backed by full warranty. We are here even the day after the renovation, for any question or need that arises.

services_p_21: We work with a permanent team of skilled professionals - plasterers, painters, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, and more. services_p_22: We also specialize in renovations for the commercial and institutional sectors - offices, stores, restaurants, hotels, clinics, and schools. We understand the special needs of businesses and institutions - fast and efficient work, minimal disruptions to ongoing operations, compliance with standards and regulations, and a professional result that conveys quality and reliability.
services_p_23: Our service for the commercial sector includes professional planning that suits the specific needs of the business, fast and efficient execution that minimizes disruptions to operations, use of quality and durable materials suitable for intensive use, compliance with all relevant standards and regulations, and full warranty for the work.
services_p_24: We understand that time is money in the business world, so we commit to meeting agreed deadlines and delivering a perfect result at maximum speed. We also offer the option to work at non-standard hours - at night or on weekends - to minimize the impact on the business's ongoing operations.
services_p_25: Electrical and lighting work are an integral part of every renovation project. We provide professional electrical services that include electrical system planning, installation of new electrical panels, electrical infrastructure layout, installation of electrical and communication points, installation of designer and functional lighting, and installation of smart systems.
services_p_26: We work with licensed and experienced electricians who thoroughly know all standards and regulations. We ensure professional and safe execution of all electrical work and provide full warranty for the work. We also offer professional consultation regarding lighting planning - where to place light points, what type of lighting to choose, and how to create a pleasant and functional atmosphere.
services_p_27: Professional plumbing work is critical to the success of any renovation project. We provide comprehensive plumbing services that include plumbing system planning, replacement of old piping, installation of hot and cold water systems, installation of quality plumbing fixtures, and solving complex plumbing problems.
services_p_28: We work with licensed and experienced plumbers who thoroughly know all types of plumbing systems. We ensure the use of quality and durable materials, professional execution according to all standards, and thorough testing after installation to ensure the system works perfectly.
services_p_29: Designer drywall ceilings can completely change the look and feel of any space. We specialize in designing and installing stunning drywall ceilings - acoustic ceilings, ceilings with recessed lighting, tiered and designer ceilings, and drywall partitions for space division.
services_p_30: We work with skilled drywall specialists who specialize in creating complex and designer ceilings. We offer professional consultation regarding ceiling design, lighting integration, and choosing the appropriate finish. The result is a stunning ceiling that gives the space a completely new dimension.
services_p_31: One of the most common questions we receive is "What is the price of bathroom renovation?" bathroom_renovation_p_18: Transform your bathroom into a sanctuary of tranquility and design. We at Shiputzim 2000 specialize in comprehensive renovations, infrastructure replacement, and innovative design for wet rooms.
bathroom_renovation_p_19: The bathroom is one of the most important and functional spaces in the home. We start our day there and end our evening there. Beyond the aesthetic aspect, bathroom renovation is a critical process for maintaining the integrity of the home. Old and rusty pipes can cause hidden leaks, wall moisture, and mold that damages health. When you choose to renovate the bathroom, you're not only upgrading your quality of life but also significantly increasing your property value.
bathroom_renovation_p_20: The renovation process requires great skill, as it combines complex systems of plumbing, electrical, and waterproofing in a relatively small space. Any small mistake in the waterproofing stage or pipe laying can be costly in the future. Therefore, choosing an experienced professional is the most important decision you'll make in this project.
bathroom_renovation_p_21: The first stage is precise planning of the new space. Then, we perform thorough dismantling of old tiles, sanitary fixtures, the old bathtub, and debris removal to an authorized site. This stage is critical for exposing existing infrastructure.
bathroom_renovation_p_22: The heart of the renovation. We replace all old piping with new standard SP or PEX piping, install new water points according to the plan, and make preparations for water-protected electrical work for lighting, heaters, and outlets.
bathroom_renovation_p_23: This is the most important stage for preventing future damage. We perform floor and wall waterproofing (in the shower area) using advanced cementitious materials (such as Sika), and conduct a 24-hour flood test to ensure complete waterproofing.
bathroom_renovation_p_24: Adhesion or laying of the ceramic and porcelain granite tiles you've chosen. The work is performed with great precision, with attention to uniform spacing (joints) and correct floor slopes for efficient water drainage to sewer openings.
bathroom_renovation_p_25: Installation of the toilet (wall-hung or monoblock), sink, bathroom cabinet, shower enclosure, and faucets. This is the stage where the room takes its final and designed form, with attention to perfect finishes.
bathroom_renovation_p_26: Painting the ceiling and walls that aren't tiled with acrylic paint that resists mold and fungi, suitable for wet rooms. Thorough cleaning and handing over the keys to your new and luxurious bathroom.
